disclaimer.content: සුව நலம் AI is NOT a medical device and does NOT provide medical diagnoses, treatment recommendations, or medical advice.
disclaimer.contentDetails: This AI tool analyzes your uploaded documents to help you better understand your medical records. All findings, including drug interaction warnings and lab trend charts, are strictly for informational purposes only.
disclaimer.warning: Always consult a qualified doctor or pharmacist before making any decisions about your health or medications.
disclaimer.riskPt1: AI predictions may contain inaccuracies or incomplete data.
disclaimer.riskPt2: Document analysis is meant for personal reference only.
disclaimer.riskPt3: Never rely solely on this tool for critical health decisions.
disclaimer.riskPt4: Emergency? Contact emergency services or visit a hospital immediately.
